intro: Written in the Basement Tapes summer of 1967, when Dylan and the Band were making music for fun in a house near Woodstock. The Band's version came first; Dylan's own studio take waited until 1971.

lives.title: The basement
lives.note: Recorded with the Band on a home tape machine. The take first came out officially in 1991, and in full on The Basement Tapes Complete.

lives.title: The Band
lives.note: Closed their first album, with Richard Manuel singing high and fragile.

lives.title: Dylan's own release
lives.note: A new recording with Happy Traum on second guitar, made for Bob Dylan's Greatest Hits Vol. II.

lives.title: The Last Waltz
lives.note: The Band's farewell concert ended with everyone on stage singing it together.

lives.title: Back after 18 years
lives.note: Played for the first time since June 2008, as the last song of the night, and kept in the set through 2026.
